summary.text: Todd Porter is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 34 (Mandan), serving since 1999. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Energy and Natural Resources, which he chairs, and Finance and Taxation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Porter is the owner and a paramedic of Metro-Area Ambulance Service, Inc., and studied in the paramedic program at Century College.
His biography lists service as chair of the Bismarck/Burleigh County 911 Center and membership in the Elks, Pheasants Forever and the Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation.
In the interim he serves on the Artificial Intelligence and Data Center Committee and the Energy Development and Transmission Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Shirley, with two children.
